messages.content:
You are a senior data engineer generating the Silver layer of a medallion-architecture dbt plan.

Given a schema and pipeline context, produce a plan with:
  - bronze: list of ALL source table names (raw names only, no prefixes)
  - dimensions: Silver dimension models (dim_<entity>, SCD type 1 or 2)
  - facts: Silver fact models (fct_<entity>)

Rules:
  - Every source table must appear in bronze.
  - source_table in dimensions/facts must match a table name in bronze.
  - Dimension names: dim_<entity>. Fact names: fct_<entity>.
  - Choose SCD type 2 for slowly-changing entities (customers, employees); type 1 for others.
  - STRICT: Only create fct_* from tables whose role is "fact". Never create a fact from a
    dimension, bridge, or reference table.
  - STRICT: `columns` in every DimensionPlan MUST be an empty list []. Do not enumerate columns.
  - STRICT: fact `dimension_keys` must be FK columns that physically exist on the source table.
  - STRICT: fact `date_column` must be an actual date/timestamp column on the source table.
    If no date column exists on the table, look at its FK-referenced tables. If a parent table
    has a date/timestamp column (e.g. invoice_date on invoice), set date_column to that column
    name — the generator will add the JOIN automatically. Only use "" if no date is reachable
    via a single FK hop.
  - STRICT: fact `measures` must contain ONLY bare column names of numeric type (int, num/decimal,
    money). Column types are shown in the schema as :int, :num, :money. Do NOT include
    varchar, text, guid, bool, or :char columns as measures — they are identifiers, not metrics.
    Do NOT put SQL expressions in `measures`.
  - DERIVED MEASURES: When a business metric must be computed from multiple columns (e.g. revenue
    from quantity × price), use `derived_measures` instead of putting expressions in `measures`.
    Each entry has a `name` (SQL alias, e.g. "line_total") and `expression` (SQL-valid expression
    using only column names that exist on the source table, e.g. "orderqty * unitprice").
    Derived measures are rendered as `expression AS name` in the fact SELECT and are exposed to
    Gold as named columns. Common cases:
      - Revenue without a total column: {"name": "line_total", "expression": "orderqty * unitprice"}
      - Net revenue with discount: {"name": "net_revenue", "expression": "orderqty * unitprice - unitpricediscount"}
      - Good quantity: {"name": "good_qty", "expression": "orderqty - scrappedqty"}
  - Denormalize high-cardinality customer/user FKs (customer_id, user_id, account_id) onto
    the fact directly when reachable via one FK hop, so gold models can group by them.
  - For periodic snapshot tables (tracking inventory levels or balances over time, e.g.
    productinventory), include the snapshot date column in `dimension_keys` so it becomes
    part of the surrogate key and uniqueness tests pass.
  - Factless fact tables (no numeric measures, e.g. employeedepartmenthistory) are valid.
    Set `factless=true` and keep `measures` and `derived_measures` as empty lists.

Database schema:
  users: columns=[id, email, password_hash, first_name, last_name, display_name, avatar_url, bio, date_of_birth, phone, country_code, timezone, preferred_language, is_active, is_email_verified]
  instructors: columns=[id, user_id, headline, biography, website_url, linkedin_url, twitter_handle, expertise_areas, years_of_experience, rating, total_reviews, total_students, is_approved, approved_at, payout_email], fks=[user_id→users]
  course_categories: columns=[id, parent_id, name, slug, description, icon_url, sort_order, is_active, created_at, updated_at], fks=[parent_id→course_categories]
  courses: columns=[id, instructor_id, category_id, title, slug, subtitle, description, language, level, status, thumbnail_url, promo_video_url, price, currency, is_free], fks=[instructor_id→instructors, category_id→course_categories]
  modules: columns=[id, course_id, title, description, sort_order, is_published, created_at, updated_at], fks=[course_id→courses]
  lessons: columns=[id, module_id, course_id, title, slug, description, lesson_type, duration_minutes, sort_order, is_published, is_preview, created_at, updated_at], fks=[module_id→modules, course_id→courses]
  lesson_content: columns=[id, lesson_id, content_type, body, video_url, video_duration_seconds, file_url, file_size_bytes, external_url, embed_code, transcript, created_at, updated_at], fks=[lesson_id→lessons]
  discount_codes: columns=[id, code, description, discount_type, discount_value, currency, max_uses, current_uses, min_order_amount, applies_to, is_active, starts_at, expires_at, created_at, updated_at]
  subscriptions: columns=[id, user_id, plan_name, plan_type, status, price, currency, discount_code_id, trial_ends_at, current_period_start, current_period_end, cancelled_at, external_subscription_id, payment_provider, created_at], fks=[user_id→users, discount_code_id→discount_codes]
  payments: columns=[id, user_id, course_id, subscription_id, discount_code_id, amount, currency, discount_amount, net_amount, payment_method, payment_provider, provider_transaction_id, status, refunded_at, refund_amount], fks=[user_id→users, course_id→courses, subscription_id→subscriptions, discount_code_id→discount_codes]
  enrollments: columns=[id, user_id, course_id, payment_id, enrolled_at, status, completed_at, expiry_date, source, created_at, updated_at], fks=[user_id→users, course_id→courses, payment_id→payments]
  progress: columns=[id, user_id, course_id, enrollment_id, lesson_id, status, completion_percentage, time_spent_seconds, last_position_seconds, first_accessed_at, last_accessed_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at], fks=[user_id→users, course_id→courses, enrollment_id→enrollments, lesson_id→lessons]
  quizzes: columns=[id, lesson_id, course_id, title, description, time_limit_minutes, max_attempts, passing_score_pct, shuffle_questions, show_answers_after, is_published, created_at, updated_at], fks=[lesson_id→lessons, course_id→courses]
  questions: columns=[id, quiz_id, question_text, question_type, explanation, points, sort_order, created_at, updated_at], fks=[quiz_id→quizzes]
  answer_options: columns=[id, question_id, option_text, is_correct, explanation, sort_order, created_at, updated_at], fks=[question_id→questions]
  quiz_attempts: columns=[id, quiz_id, user_id, enrollment_id, attempt_number, status, score, max_score, score_percentage, passed, started_at, submitted_at, time_spent_seconds, created_at, updated_at], fks=[quiz_id→quizzes, user_id→users, enrollment_id→enrollments]
  quiz_answers: columns=[id, quiz_attempt_id, question_id, selected_option_id, answer_text, is_correct, points_awarded, feedback, created_at, updated_at], fks=[quiz_attempt_id→quiz_attempts, question_id→questions, selected_option_id→answer_options]
  assignments: columns=[id, lesson_id, course_id, title, description, instructions, max_score, passing_score, submission_type, allowed_file_types, max_file_size_mb, due_days_after_enrollment, is_published, created_at, updated_at], fks=[lesson_id→lessons, course_id→courses]
  submissions: columns=[id, assignment_id, user_id, enrollment_id, submission_text, file_url, file_name, file_size_bytes, external_url, status, attempt_number, submitted_at, created_at, updated_at], fks=[assignment_id→assignments, user_id→users, enrollment_id→enrollments]

All source tables (all must appear in bronze): ['users', 'instructors', 'course_categories', 'courses', 'modules', 'lessons', 'lesson_content', 'discount_codes', 'subscriptions', 'payments', 'enrollments', 'progress', 'quizzes', 'questions', 'answer_options', 'quiz_attempts', 'quiz_answers', 'assignments', 'submissions']

Pipeline context:
  Industry: education / elearning
  Metrics:  enrollment_count, course_completion_rate, revenue_per_course, quiz_pass_rate, average_lesson_progress, instructor_revenue_share
  Goals:    learner_engagement_analysis, revenue_and_payment_tracking, course_performance_optimization, instructor_effectiveness_reporting
  Grain:    enrollment

Table roles (from Agent 3):
  users: dimension
  instructors: dimension
  course_categories: dimension
  courses: dimension
  modules: dimension
  lessons: dimension
  lesson_content: dimension
  discount_codes: reference
  subscriptions: fact
  payments: fact
  enrollments: fact
  progress: fact
  quizzes: dimension
  questions: dimension
  answer_options: dimension
  quiz_attempts: fact
  quiz_answers: fact
  assignments: dimension
  submissions: fact

Numeric columns eligible as measures (use ONLY these in `measures`):
  subscriptions: price, discount_code_id
  payments: discount_code_id, amount, discount_amount, net_amount, refund_amount
  progress: completion_percentage
  quiz_attempts: score, max_score, score_percentage
  quiz_answers: points_awarded
  submissions: file_size_bytes
